purpose: Insist that an outcome stays the same despite any condition.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
V volitional + が / と; い-adjective stem + かろうが; N + だろうと
Whoever opposes it, I will continue.
However far away it is, I will go to see them.
Please report the result, whatever it may be.
formation: V volitional + が / と; い-adjective stem + かろうが; N + だろうと
restrictions: Often paired with question words such as 誰 or 何.
mistake: The volitional form is concessive here, not an invitation.
